decisions.proposed_text: Nhắm tới vị trí mạnh nhất, đánh đâu thắng đó!\nCô nàng bất hảo phi thường, hoàn hảo không tì vết
decisions.reason: Càng chiến càng thắng is an awkward rendering of 屡战屡胜. Revision keeps the repeated-victory boast and flawless delinquent characterization naturally.

decisions.proposed_text: 『Nhanh nhất』chính là đỉnh cao kỹ nghệ\nMã Nương nghệ nhân kiên cường, bất khuất
decisions.reason: Current second line uses forbidden generic Uma Musume for 马娘; revision also smooths the stacked adjectives.
decisions.terminology_basis: Project world-term rule applies to generic 马娘/赛马娘 as Mã Nương; Uma Musume is reserved for the franchise title.

decisions.reason: The 天下统一 slogan and no-reason-needed pursuit of dreams are faithfully and naturally preserved.
Accurately preserves the struggle between reason and instinct and the alluring person carrying deep desire.
Catchphrase, ☆ markers, feng-shui identity, and meddlesome personality are all preserved naturally.
